text: Provisional ballots are only counted when an election is close.

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Provisional Voting
truthSource.oneLine: A provisional ballot is counted once officials confirm you’re registered in that county and haven’t already voted, whatever the margin. You can look up whether yours counted.

lesson.tip: “Provisional” means checked first, not counted only if needed. When a term sounds ominous, look up its official definition before passing on what it “means.”
